{{Top|leg}}
A '''computer interface tether''' was part of a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid's]] standard equipment. It had a range of five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and when connected to a medical mainframe it allowed the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] access to advanced medical information, historical data, and patient archives.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
